scope: Three pinned publisher PDF originals, one original DOCX control, and the existing qualified ECMA-derived SF artifact; separate CPU/memory runs and one caller-buffer A/B pair. No production codec optimization.
method: Go pprof -raw; flat owner is first innermost symbol; inclusive symbols counted once per sample (recursive ancestors deduplicated). Percentages overlap. Heap indexes are sampled allocation blocks/bytes, MemStats records exact counters. CPU samples are not OS CPU accounting or latency shares. Write_delta profiles subtract read_live from write_live. Raw artifacts remain ignored locally.
